graph.keyboardHint: Arrow keys move to the nearest node in that direction. Enter loads its neighbours in the explorer, opens a group or does the panel’s click action. Space adds the node to the selection or takes it out, P pins it, S shows only the selection, Ctrl+Z takes back a step, Escape clears the selection. Plus and minus zoom, 0 shows everything.
graph.communities.tooLarge: Communities are computed for graphs up to {limit} nodes.
graph.notice.cut: Showing the {shown} best connected of {count} nodes, the limit of this panel. Narrow the query or raise the limit in the panel options.
graph.notice.truncated: The data source cut the result at its limit, so the graph may be incomplete.
graph.notice.dangling: {count} edges lead to nodes outside the result and are not drawn.
graph.notice.clustered: More than {nodes} nodes or {edges} edges: nodes are grouped by label. Open a group to see its nodes.
graph.notice.noWebgl: This browser cannot draw graphs (WebGL 2 is missing), so the graph is shown as a table.
graph.notice.cycles: {count} edges close a cycle and point upwards.
graph.cluster.caption: {label} ({count})
graph.explorer.noKind: The explorer is not available for this kind of data source.
graph.explorer.noRight: Loading neighbours needs query access to the data source.
graph.explorer.notGraph: The data source did not answer with a graph.
graph.gesture.wheel: Hold Ctrl to zoom with the wheel
graph.gesture.touch: Use two fingers to move the graph
graph.time.label: Graph at
graph.table.name: Name
graph.path.none: The result has no paths. Return paths from the query, for example with shortestPath.
graph.path.title: Path {number}, {count} steps
graph.options.caption: Node name property (optional)
graph.options.captionHint: Empty uses name, title or a similar property.
graph.options.colorByHint: Communities are computed for graphs up to {limit} nodes.
graph.options.colorBy.label: Label
graph.options.edgeWidthByHint: A number property of the edges, such as weight. Empty draws all edges equally.
graph.options.nodeLimitHint: At most {max}. Beyond the limit, the best connected nodes are shown.
graph.options.cluster.label: Always
graph.options.timePropertyHint: Edges with a timestamp in this property get a time slider.
graph.options.explorer: Explorer on when the panel opens
graph.options.variableHint: A dashboard variable, so other panels follow the node.
graph.options.variableNone: The dashboard has no variables yet. Add one in the dashboard settings.
graph.announce.variableRefused: ${name} has no value {value}, so it stays as it is.
graph.explorer.noTigerGraph: The explorer is not available for TigerGraph sources.
graph.steps.title: Steps
graph.steps.limitHint: At most {max}. The best connected neighbours come first.
graph.steps.yours: The exploration is yours and belongs to this view; it changes neither the panel nor its query.
graph.steps.openQuery: Open as a query in Explore
graph.steps.confirmText: This takes back {count} steps and the nodes they loaded. Pinned nodes stay.
graph.selection.title: Selection
graph.selection.hint: Shift+click adds nodes. Enter loads the neighbours of the chosen node.
graph.selection.onlySummary: Only the selection: {shown} of {count} nodes, {edges} between them.
graph.pin.title: Pinned
graph.pin.hint: Pinned nodes stay when you take back steps, and are kept for you on this panel.
graph.sheet.label: Selection and pinned nodes
graph.hierarchy.tooLarge: A hierarchy shows up to {limit} nodes; the result has {count}. Narrow the query, for example to one root and three levels, or show it as a network.
graph.layout.label: Layout
graph.legend.title: Labels
graph.options.hierarchyLayoutHint: ELK (Eclipse Layout Kernel) loads only when a panel uses it; the first time takes a moment longer.
graph.options.elkEdgeRoutingHint: Edges are drawn straight; the routing sets how much room ELK keeps for them between layers.
graph.layout.elkRunning: Loading ELK and arranging the graph…
graph.layout.elkFailed: ELK could not arrange this graph, so it shows Kalzit’s layout.
graph.layout.elkTooLarge: Without web workers ELK arranges at most {limit} nodes, so this graph shows Kalzit’s layout.
graph.options.colorSchemeHint: Nodes without the property are gray and listed so in the legend. Text properties get a palette color per value.
graph.options.labelColorsHint: Colors from the palette in the order of the labels; a color of its own stays with the label.
graph.options.clickActionHint: The details and the selection work with every action.
graph.steps.tooManyForQuery: More than {max} nodes are shown, too many to open as a query. Show only a selection first.
graph.variable.capped: ${name} takes the first {count} values; the others of the selection are left out.
